title: Point the workflow surfaces at the principle index
action: Close the loop so a reader arriving from the workflow side finds the principle set. THREE pointer edits, and NOT ONE of them names or lists a principle — the index's classes: lines are the single home of which principles a class gets, and bee orient derives the list from them. (1) skills/bee-planning/references/planning-reference.md, the '## Class playbooks' preamble (around line 176, beside the existing 'How a plan uses one' paragraph): one short paragraph saying the routed principles for a class are named by bee orient in the session preamble, read from the '## Principle homes' section of docs/knowledge/areas/doctrine-layer/router-triage-and-the-agents-md-duplication-boundary.md, and that a playbook never restates them. (2) skills/bee-planning/SKILL.md: one row in its References table pointing at the same section, with a 'When to load' that says: the routed principles for this class, and what each one's spoken line is. (3) skills/bee-hive/SKILL.md: one row in its '## References' table (line 121 onward) pointing at the same section, so the router itself names where the principle set lives. Keep every addition SHORT — these are pointers, not a second copy of the layer. Do NOT edit any file under expertise/ (CONTEXT.md D1 and decision 'Slice 3 does NOT touch expertise/'); the guides carry a portability law at expertise/README.md:7-9 that forbids them referencing skills. After the edits run .bee/bin/bee dev regen so the changed skills reach both plugin trees.
verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --no-fail-fast --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml --test pointer_integrity --test principle_index_parity && .bee/bin/bee knowledge check && .bee/bin/bee dev release-manifest --check

truths: No pointer names a principle or lists a class's principle set — the index classes: lines stay the single home and bee orient stays the only deriver (bee-principle-single-source-of-truth).
No file under expertise/ is edited — the guides' portability law at expertise/README.md:7-9 forbids a guide referencing a skill.
Every added path resolves; pointer_integrity stays green.
The additions are pointers, a few lines each — a second copy of the layer inside a playbook is the failure this cell exists to avoid.
bee dev regen runs so the three changed skill files reach both plugin trees.

trace.outcome: Three short pointers route workflow readers to the Principle homes index; no principle named

report.outcome: Three short pointers route workflow readers to the Principle homes index; no principle named
report.tests: cargo test --release --test pointer_integrity --test principle_index_parity; bee knowledge check; bee dev release-manifest --check — green:unit — pointer and principle-index parity plus manifest parity cover a docs-pointer change
